north_star.headline: Be a hub, not a leaf
north_star.body: Tesla × cabin Grok × CoS × calendar/mail × house displays × life logistics through one personal OS. Navy career pays the bills ~7 more years. This layer is life admin, not a startup. Plant edges now so the phase change finds you already connected.
